name: ypcb-ddr3-1066
label: measured
description: The production card (Inspur YPCB-00338, Kintex-7 xc7k480t): one slice at 133.33 MHz, two DDR3-1066 channels through LiteDRAM (17.1 GB/s peak), the stream engine. Measured with tools/qual/perf.py (README Results). The existing DDR configuration the design supports in the tree; the Verilator LDC co-simulation (OTPU_LDC=1066) runs the card's own controller.

refresh.note: opentpu.profile.ddr3_plusargs carries the calibrated bank model (ROW_BANK_COLUMN, 300 ns)

measured.tool: tools/qual/perf.py (64 greedy tokens after a 512-token prompt; device = accelerator cycles only)
